title: Juicy Greek Garlic Stew
description: A rich, garlicky stew with tender lamb and a hint of sweetness, perfect for a sick day.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, 1 1/2 pounds, boneless and cut into 2-inch pieces
Garlic, 6 cloves, minced
ingredients.notes: Reduce to 3 cloves if you prefer less garlic

ingredients.name: Red wine, 1 cup (optional)
ingredients.notes: Can be substituted with beef broth

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the chopped onion to the pot. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the red wine (if using), beef broth, dried oregano, dried thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the golden caster sugar. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes, or until the stew has reduced slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
